component.name: Vidra
component.summary: The ultimate, lightning-fast video download manager

description.p: Meet Vidra, the ultimate open-source video download manager designed for power users who demand speed, reliability, and a beautiful interface. Built with a modern Flutter frontend and a robust Python backend (powered by yt-dlp and FFmpeg), Vidra brings a premium downloading experience right to your Linux desktop!
Whether you need to download a single video or manage a large queue of media, Vidra provides a seamless and fast experience without relying on command-line interfaces.

ul.li: Support for hundreds of video platforms via the embedded yt-dlp engine.
Automatic media processing and merging using bundled FFmpeg and QuickJS.
Clean and responsive user interface with full dark mode support.
Privacy-Focused & Open Source: Zero telemetry, completely offline-first, and FOSS.
Built-in Over-The-Air (OTA) updates to keep the downloader engine always up to date.
